error[L0321]: this is not a well-formed floating-point literal
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/hexadecimal-float-without-point-is-fixed/main.ldn:1:14
  |
1 | scale: f64 = 0x1p-20
  |              ^^^^^^^
  = note: [0210] [0220]: a float literal needs a point with digits on both sides even when it has an exponent, as in `1.0e10` and `0x1.0p-20`
  = help: write `.0` before `the exponent`
